articles.summary: LISLE, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- SunCoke Energy, Inc. (NYSE: SXC) plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, before trading opens on the New York Stock Exchange.
